items.title: Accenture (ACN) Stock Is Up, What You Need To Know

items.summary: Accenture (ACN) stock has rallied about 23% over the past three months. Over the past twelve months it is still down 17%, while the S&P 500 gained 17%. Owners feel relief, and those who missed it feel left behind.

items.title: Could You Have Seen Accenture Stock's Rebound Coming?
items.summary: Accenture (ACN) stock rose roughly 43% between June 18 and September 18, 2026, while the S&P 500 gained 2.3%. The run began near its 52-week low, on the day the company reported fiscal Q3 2026 and announced a much larger push into security software and smaller clients. That push had been building in plain sight across three earlier earnings calls. Whether spotting it would have made you money is a harder question.

items.title: Accenture Up on Partnership with Anthropic; Novo Nordisk Falls on Turnaround | Stock Movers
items.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Novo Nordisk (NVO) shares are lower as it disappointed investors hoping for concrete turnaround plans from Chief Executive Officer Mike Doustdar after losing its lead in the obesity market to Eli Lilly & Co. The company pledged to launch more than five blockbusters and deliver more than $23 billion in new sales in coming years, but investors are selling shares due to lack of concrete news. - Arhaus (ARHS) is moving after Jefferies upgraded the furniture company to buy from hold, writing that it has "newfound optimism on the retailer's strategy to elevate brand awareness" and improve market share. - Accenture (ACN) is up on news Anthropic is partnering with Accenture to test the safety of its advanced artificial intelligence models by embedding evaluators from the consulting firm directly within its operations.
